Job title
Data Analyst II

Reporting To
Lead Data Analyst

Branch
Gurugram

Job Summary/About the Role
We are looking for a Data Analyst II with 4–6 years of experience in data analytics and business intelligence. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in Power BI, SQL, Python, and Azure, along with exposure to the insurance domain. This role involves building dashboards, analysing data, and supporting senior analysts and business stakeholders in driving data-driven decisions.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, 

• Experience: 4–6 years in data analytics, BI development, or related roles.
Technical Expertise:
• Strong proficiency in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query).
• Solid SQL skills for querying and data manipulation.
• Working knowledge of Python for analytics and automation.
• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Domain Knowledge: Exposure to insurance industry processes and KPIs.
• Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

Key Responsibilities
Data Analytics & Reporting
• Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports to support business needs.
• Perform data analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and insights.
• Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency in reporting.
Technical Skills
• Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction and transformation.
• Use Python for data cleaning, automation, and analysis tasks.
• Work with Azure services (Data Factory, SQL Database, Synapse) for cloud-based data solutions.
Domain Expertise
• Apply knowledge of the insurance domain to interpret data and provide meaningful insights.
• Collaborate with business teams to translate requirements into analytical solutions.
Collaboration
• Work closely with senior analysts and developers to deliver projects on time.
• Support cross-functional teams with ad-hoc analysis and reporting.
• Contribute to documentation, best practices, and process improvements.

Customer Retention Manager

 

The Customer Retention Manager is responsible for reducing churn, improving customer health, and protecting recurring revenue through early risk detection, cross‑functional mitigation, and scalable retention programs. The role partners closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Competitive Intelligence, and Pricing & Packaging to orchestrate coordinated customer‑save strategies.

This role also provides renewal objection handling expertise, enabling teams to navigate downsells, downgrades, competitive threats, pricing pushback, TCO/ROI concerns, and budget constraints. The ideal candidate excels at influencing cross‑functional teams, handling commercial risk, and translating customer insights into save actions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Churn Risk Identification & Health Intelligence

  • Maintain a standardized customer risk scoring framework leveraging health signals, product usage, support patterns, sentiment, and competitive exposure.
  • Identify early risk indicators (e.g., discount cliffs, adoption gaps, under-deployed licenses, sponsor turnover).
  • Partner with Renewal Ops, Data team to automate risk workflows in Salesforce
  • Collaborate with Competitive Intelligence to map competitive displacement trends and update counter strategies.

2. Cross‑Functional Risk Orchestration (Renewals, CS, CI, Pricing)

  • Lead weekly renewal risk reviews/war rooms with Renewals, CSMs/CEMs, and Sales to align on mitigation actions.
  • Build account-level mitigation plans that include adoption interventions, executive alignment, value reinforcement, and commercial flexibility.
  • Partner with Pricing & Packaging and Deal Desk to design controlled commercial offers (e.g., term/ramp, New Product Introductions, New SKU Impact, Product Bundling etc).
  • Escalate systemic product, billing, or support issues and track resolution.

3. Renewal Objection Handling 

Serve as the subject‑matter expert for Renewals by providing guidance, playbooks, and strategic support to overcome critical renewal objections.

  • Diagnose downsell and downgrade risks, recommend right‑sizing strategies, and deliver value‑based narratives to reinforce ROI and prevent unnecessary revenue loss.
  • Partner with Competitive Intelligence to address competitive pricing challenges, coach teams on TCO and switching‑cost comparisons, and collaborate with Pricing on controlled incentive structures.
  • Provide Renewals reps with ROI models, justification materials, payment‑flexibility options, pricing guardrails, and negotiation strategies to resolve budget and pricing objections while protecting retention revenue.

4. Preemptive Retention Programs

  • Launch and manage proactive churn-prevention programs, such as:
    • Early renewal health checks
    • Competitive threat campaigns
    • Discount cliff mitigation
  • Develop and maintain risk playbooks for teams to execute consistently.
  • Partner with Enablement to deliver training on objection handling and retention strategies.

5. Insights, Reporting & Executive Readouts

  • Deliver monthly churn insights including root causes, save rates, objection trends, and program impact.
  • Own cohort analyses, risk heatmaps, and retention dashboards.
  • Provide actionable recommendations to Product, Pricing, Support, and Leadership teams.
  • Support Renewal forecast accuracy through risk scoring and save probability modeling.

6. Process, Tooling & Enablement

  • Improve CRM/CS tool workflows to enhance visibility into churn risk and save motions.
  • Standardize processes for risk identification, objection handling, escalations, and mitigation SLAs.
  • Build and maintain a knowledge base of objection-handling scripts, competitive counters, and case studies.
  • Deliver enablement sessions to strengthen Renewals capabilities in handling commercial objections.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in Renewals, Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Operations (SaaS preferred).
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen with experience handling pricing, TCO, ROI, and competitive objections.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and lead risk discussions with executive stakeholders.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight/CS platforms, and BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict‑resolution skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in competitive intelligence, pricing strategy, or deal desk functions.
  • Experience running war rooms or escalation workflows.
  • Background in program management or enablement.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics: GRR, NRR, churn, discount impact, unit economics.

Key Metrics (KPIs)

  • Gross Renewal Rate(GRR)
  • Net Renewal Rate (NRR)
  • Revenue and logo churn rates
  • Save rate on at‑risk renewals
  • Early risk detection rate
  • Renewal forecast accuracy
  • Adoption/health score improvement
  • Discount hygiene and cost-to-save efficiency
  • Time-to-mitigation for escalated risks

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 2–5 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

About The Role

We are looking for a skilled AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI solutions. You will work closely with data scientists, product teams, and engineers to build scalable, high-performance AI models that solve real-world problems.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI solutions
• Build and optimize data pipelines for model training and inference
• Work on supervised and unsupervised learning, NLP, or computer vision use cases
• Evaluate, tune, and improve model performance
• Deploy models into production and collaborate with MLOps teams
• Monitor model performance and retrain models as needed
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into AI solutions
• Document models, experiments, and processes

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 2–5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related roles
• Strong programming skills in Python
• Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
• Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms and statistics
• Experience with data processing libraries (Pandas, NumPy)
• Knowledge of SQL and data handling techniques
• Experience deploying ML models in production environments

Good to Have

• Experience with NLP, Computer Vision, or Generative AI
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
• Exposure to MLOps tools and practices
• Experience with APIs, microservices, and containerization

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and ML projects
• Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment
• Career growth and learning opportunities
